#!/bin/bash
set -u
mkdir -p /tmp/_xm_front_sync
echo '=== 同步 memory.html ==='
rm -f /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_0
curl -fsSL 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mo-xing-alt/xinmo-site/c6ab7acad8c783551b292df06011ec173bebb461/memory.html' -o /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_0 || curl -fsSL -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github.raw' -H 'User-Agent: xinmo-vps-sync' 'https://api.github.com/repos/mo-xing-alt/xinmo-site/contents/memory.html?ref=c6ab7acad8c783551b292df06011ec173bebb461' -o /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_0 || { echo '下载失败: memory.html'; exit 11; }
GOT_SHA=$(sha256sum /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_0 | awk '{print $1}')
if [ "$GOT_SHA" != 'df144ff8a789bba86d87af8d2eae930987789b742894180ce454e9d27503b4de' ]; then echo "SHA256 不匹配: got=$GOT_SHA expect=df144ff8a789bba86d87af8d2eae930987789b742894180ce454e9d27503b4de"; exit 12; fi
sudo install -D -m 644 -o root -g root /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_0 '/var/www/xinmo-site/memory.html'
ls -l --time-style=+%H:%M:%S '/var/www/xinmo-site/memory.html'
sha256sum '/var/www/xinmo-site/memory.html'
echo '=== 同步 assets/js/memory-graph.js ==='
